units: <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 34:2">Lev. R. s. 34</cite> <he>בשעה שנפשך מְצַפְצֶפֶת לצאת וכ׳</he> when thy soul shall press to get out of thy body (when thou art dangerously ill), I will restore it to thee.

senses.gloss: (cmp. צִמְצֵם) to be pressed, be in want of.
units: <cite ref="Menachot 85b">Men. 85ᵇ</cite> <he>נִצְטַפְצְפוּ אנשי וכ׳</he> Ar. (ed. <he>נצרכו להן</he>, Ms. M. <he>נצטרכו</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) the Laodiceans were in want of oil.
